source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 480 introduced an immediate searching class separate from an older debounce. Current reflectFiltererResults toggles searching from gViewWrapper.searching and returns when gDBView is absent; the old filterActive delay is gone. Keep UI state tied to the view lifecycle and avoid copying historical timers as current behavior.
title: Derive searching UI state from the actual view state
